definitions: To cook (an egg) without its shell in or over boiling water.
To cook (fish, chicken, etc.) gently in a small amount of liquid.
To illegally hunt or catch (game or fish) on land that is not one's own or in contravention of official protection.
To take an employee or customer from another company or competitor, typically by offering them a better deal.
examples: She likes to poach eggs for breakfast.
The chef decided to poach the salmon.
They were caught trying to poach deer.
Our rivals are always trying to poach our best staff.
